estimates.assumptions: 2 kg raw beef stew meat; plain meat has no carbohydrates
1 Knorr beef stock cube (~4 g total weight); typical values ~2 g carbs per cube
1 tbs (15 ml) regular soy sauce; ~1 g carbs from small amount of wheat/sugar
2 cups (480 ml) water contributes no carbohydrates
1 medium green bell pepper (~120 g); standard USDA values for raw pepper
1 medium red bell pepper (~120 g); standard USDA values for raw pepper
1 medium potato (~150 g raw); standard values ~17 g carbs/100 g
1 medium carrot (~80 g raw); standard values ~10 g carbs/100 g
8 oz (227 g) canned tomato puree; ~9 g carbs/100 g with ~2 g fiber/100 g
3 tbs (45 g) smooth peanut butter; standard ~20 g carbs/100 g
5 g chili powder; typical ~60 g carbs/100 g with high fiber content
1 medium onion (~110 g raw); standard ~9 g carbs/100 g
5 cloves garlic (~15 g total raw); standard ~27 g carbs/100 g
3 tbs (45 ml) olive oil; pure oil has no carbohydrates
